thread:
emily: Heads-up — scheduling Peregrine dedicated rollout for 2024-11-12 02:00 UTC. Quick summary: drain slice-7, pin serving runtime to v2.14.1, prime KV cache, canary at 100rps for 10m, then gradual 10% shifts. Need Ops + Security ack and rollback gates.

deploybot: @channel Deploy scheduled by emily for 2024-11-12T02:00:00Z (thread 3812345678). Canaries: slice-7 -> 100rps x 10m. Rollout steps created: 10%/25%/50%/100%. Pin set to v2.14.1.

dmitri: noted. i'll own the drain and eviction checks. on the drain: we'll run `kubectl cordon && kubectl drain --ignore-daemonsets` then validate no active KV sessions on that slice. will post logs.

sre-oncall: thx. propose rollback triggers: error-rate > 1.5% sustained for 5m OR p95 latency increase > 500ms vs baseline for 5m. also circuit-break if tail latency spikes during canary.

maria: security note — there's a KMS rotation scheduled at 02:15 UTC in the customer tenant window. that's after the planned start but before full traffic shift. we should either delay rotation or ensure the rollout can tolerate key churn. pinging @karen-sec for KMS confirmation.

karen: confirmed — we can move the rotation to 04:00 UTC for Peregrine if needed. prefer to avoid coupling deploy and rotation. recommend delaying rotation to 04:00.

emily: thanks. we'll push rotation to 04:00. update: change window stays 02:00-03:00 UTC. plan: start canary at 02:00, hold at 10%/25% while we watch metrics for 15m, then 50%/100% if good.

liam: small request — can we pin the model artifact hash too? previously saw silent regressions when only runtime pinned. e.g.: `model:@sha256:8a7f...` — deploybot, can you attach artifact hash to the rollout?

deploybot: Artifact hash support added to rollout request. Attached: model_hash=8a7f3b2c9d. Runtime_pin=v2.14.1.

dmitri: KV priming plan: pre-warm with the following script 15m before canary start:
```
for key in $(cat seed_keys.txt); do curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $PEREGRINE_KEY" https://kv.peregrine/api/get/$key >/dev/null; done
```
I will run from infra-runner-3.

sre-oncall: add metric checks:
- canary error-rate (5m) < 0.8%
- p95 latency delta < 200ms
- token-generation failure rate = 0
If any gate fails we abort and rollback to v2.14.0.

maria: audit/logging checklist: ensure full request/response logs retained per tenant policy for 24h and that KMS key usage events are recorded. I'll verify post-deploy.

karen: security ack given conditional on rotation moved to 04:00 and KMS usage logs verified.

emily: preflight checklist (short):
- [x] Pin runtime v2.14.1 + model_hash 8a7f3b2c9d (deploybot attached)
- [x] KMS rotation deferred to 04:00 (karen ack)
- [x] Drain slice-7 owner: dmitri
- [ ] KV priming 15m before start (dmitri)
- [x] Rollback rules defined (sre-oncall)
- [ ] Post-canary perf check + ops greenlight (liam)

liam: i'll watch the canary dashboards and give greenlight at 02:20 if metrics stable. if anything funky i'll call rollback and notify here. :thumbsup:

deploybot: preflight run queued: `deployctl preflight --customer peregrine --slice 7 --pin runtime=v2.14.1 --model-hash=8a7f3b2c9d` output will be posted to #eng-releases soon.

emily: final ask — if we need to abort, rollback target is runtime v2.14.0 + model_hash=6b2c1a4f. rollback will be automated on gate fail but ops should be ready to manual step in.

sre-oncall: added escalation steps: 1) auto-rollback by deploybot; 2) pager to oncall if rollback triggers; 3) incident channel created if > 3 rollback attempts.

maria: noted. i'll check logs after canary end and confirm KMS usage.

dmitri: I'll post drain + priming logs to this thread when done. starting drain rehearsal at 01:30 UTC.

emily: great — thanks everyone. leaving this as the approval thread. if no objections before 01:45 UTC i'll mark go-for-deploy.

liam: go-for-deploy from me pending preflight output.

karen: security go.

emily: Go recorded. Deploybot will start at 02:00 UTC.

deploybot: Deploy started: canary -> slice-7 at 02:00:00Z. Monitoring gates enabled. Audit id: rb-3812345678-01.

emily: (will update thread with canary status)
